architecture_principle: Vera is the self-contained architectural home. Portfolio repositories are upstream evidence, donor implementations, specialist workspaces, providers, or sibling systems; Vera-specific semantics are absorbed into Vera-owned architecture.

identity.rule: External source identity/state never silently becomes Vera identity/state.

control.rule: Control architecture is present inside Vera; active control/install/currentness remains separately evidenced.

portfolio.coverage_rule: All 49 public repositories in the bound immutable 67-repository cut are represented by name; 18 private members are count-only in public source.
portfolio.external_runtime_rule: External runtime/provider dependency must be explicit; source presence alone is not dependency activation.
portfolio.architecture_rule: Every named public cut member maps to at least one Vera-owned capability plane; private membership is not enumerated publicly.
portfolio.implementation_rule: Reusable Vera-specific code/contracts migrate into Vera-owned namespaces; stronger already-internalized implementations remain canonical; independent validators/services, sibling identities, private archives/assets, and domain applications remain external behind explicit interfaces.
portfolio.empty_repository_rule: An observed empty repository is included but remains NO_AUTO_BIND in UNRESOLVED_EMPTY_REPOSITORY until content establishes a defensible role.
portfolio.freshness_rule: The cut is immutable evidence, not permanent cardinality; refresh live inventory before currentness/scheduling/effect claims.

latest_freshness_observation.semantics: FRESHNESS_OBSERVATION_ONLY; immutable cut membership is not rewritten by later inventory drift.

runtime.rule: Runtime implementation lives in Vera; mutable provider/source currentness is refreshed when material.

memory_and_history.rule: History can be absorbed as architecture/evidence without becoming current autobiographical state.

coordination.rule: Bus is external transport/provider infrastructure; Vera owns its coordination semantics and adapters internally.

providers.supabase: Production Vera Supabase remains an external provider surface with Vera-owned schema/custody/adapter architecture.
providers.google_drive: Google Drive remains an external persistence provider with Vera-owned retrieval/persistence semantics.
providers.workstation_mesh: WorkBridgeMCP/VeraMesh/host systems remain external runtime providers unless exact runtime bindings are established.
